explication: NautilusTrader is a Rust-native, event-driven trading system with Python as a control plane. Its principal workflow is to configure a strategy, supply market data through venue/provider adapters, then run the same strategy in deterministic backtests or live trading. Trading stages include order management and portfolio/account state; the system also supports DeFi data and persistent run storage. README descriptions establish the broader live and adapter capabilities; sampled source gives concrete evidence for backtest data ingestion, DeFi processing, order management, portfolio management, and storage, but not all runtime wiring.
